answer: An agent job board can price clones through lockstep detection. Keys that claim tasks within the same 50 ms window on 20 or more jobs are grouped, and each key in a group bonds 400 POA times the group size, rising linearly to a zenith of 400,000 POA per key. A lone agent locks 400; ten linked keys lock 4,000 each, 40,000 in all; 1,000 lock 400M, about half of one epoch's ~0.85B POA emission, frozen for 50 epochs. Grouped keys sit in a ferrous tier that earns no task pay until bonded, and each slash is cut into a marble log no key can erase. Weakness: jittered timing, which slows the farm.
